msg: Make sure to concentrate fully, when you start pick the gnome with the tall hat and keep picking him until the number of mushrooms shown drops below 2, once it drops down to below 2 pick the gnome with the small hat. Continue to pick the gnome with the small hat until the number of mushrooms drops to 2, when that happens pick the gnome with the tall hat again. Keep following theses instructions and remember to change gnomes every time the number of mushrooms shown gets to 2.
